description: Cells by address, typed, row by row, each with its address; paged. Options add number formats, formula text (f), comments, hyperlinks, merged areas. cut says what a page left out; pass next_cursor back for more.

cells_only.description: A cell or range inside a table: read just those cells, as stored, not its table rows. Default false.

columns.description: Only these columns of a t: or d: target (or of the table rows a cell is in), in order.

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous page, with the same target.

doc.description: Document id; not needed for a dataset (d:).

formats.description: Add format, the number format code.

key.description: Column holding target's key (Code for t:Parts/BX-17) if several key_candidates; not one to read.

limit.description: Rows per page. Default 50, at most 500.

markdown.description: Text as Markdown (**bold**, lists). Default false.

max_chars.description: Characters per page. Default and at most 24000.

merges.description: List the merged areas over the rows.

sources.description: d: only: add each value's source cells (8, more counted); for one value, all, paged.

target.description: A cell or range (Stock!A1:H40, Stock!A:C, 'Q3 sales'!$K$83), table or region (t:Products: its data rows), column (t:Products[Price]), row (t:Products/#5, t:Products/SKU-0042) or value; * is every row (t:Products/*/Price); or a dataset (d:by_region), as tables. A cell or range inside one table's data rows reads those whole table rows.

validations.description: List data validations over the target (type, cells, list source).

name: xlsx_read
